notes.title: Introducing Trading Cards
notes.content:
With Summer Sale shining upon us with its discount rays, we’ve decided to give you an extra reason to get back to Diggles/Wiggles one more time and remind yourself why do you probably have a love/hate relationship with it! This time you can at least bank some Steam Trading Cards on your way out as a small 'thank you' for playing another session. Who knows, maybe one day we won't hate this old gem for anything at all.

A badge, trading cards, profile backgrounds & emoticons - a complete package is live now.
